help: Your donation helps us help others.
lead: Your donation supports us in our mission to help fight back, inspire hope, and improve the lives of those living with Parkinson’s Disease. PunchWorX is determined to make life better for people with Parkinson’s TODAY.
gift: Your gift provides vital resources for our exercise class programming and instruction, to effectively support individuals at any stage of their Parkinson’s Disease. We are continually working to improve quality of life through exercise & education.
